Where to Stay in Samut Sakhon?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites!
heroSub: 12 hand-picked Samut Sakhon hotels across every budget — a brand-new 4-star hotel with a pool, a spacious value hotel near the industrial estate, a boutique resort on the Tha Chin River, and budget stays in central Mahachai. Covering Mahachai town, Khok Kham, Tha Chin and Krathum Baen. From roughly ฿600–1,100/night.
introH2: 🦐 Why does choosing the right area in Samut Sakhon matter?
introHtml: Samut Sakhon (Mahachai) is a coastal town near Bangkok that people visit for very different reasons — to eat seafood, for business near the industrial estates, or to swing by the Talad Talay Thai seafood market and Mahachai market. Stays fall into four sides with different feels — central Mahachai is near the railway station, markets and food, ideal without a car; Khok Kham is just outside town, near Talad Talay Thai and the Sinsakhon estate, quiet and restful; Tha Chin sits by the river and the estates; and Krathum Baen–Om Noi is on the Phetkasem Road side, handy for western Bangkok. Many people book without checking the area and end up driving back and forth all day. This guide rounds up 12 hand-picked Samut Sakhon hotels across every tier — all with real guest reviews, prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Samut Sakhon has no metro, but its trump card is that Mahachai railway station (the Mae Klong line) sits in the town centre — take the train from Wongwian Yai and walk straight out to the markets and seafood restaurants. From Bangkok it's about a 40–45 minute drive on Rama II Road. Pick by your plans: central Mahachai (Tha Chalom–Mahachai) is near the railway station, Mahachai market, CentralPlaza and seafood spots, best without a car; Khok Kham is near Talad Talay Thai, the Phan Thai Norasing shrine and the Sinsakhon estate, good for self-drivers; Tha Chin sits by the Tha Chin River and the estates; and Krathum Baen–Om Noi is on the Phetkasem side, close to western Bangkok. Almost every hotel has free parking, so they suit self-drivers well.

entries.name: Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khok Kham · near Talad Talay Thai
entries.addr: 88/168 Moo 7, Khok Kham, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.3 — Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL is the brand-new 4-star hotel that opened in 2025 and climbed to the top of the province fast. Its 63 airy rooms, many with a canal-view balcony, come with an outdoor pool, a gym and a golf-simulator bar you won't find at other hotels nearby. Real guest reviews consistently praise the cleanliness and the spacious rooms. The trade-off is the Khok Kham location outside town, where it's still quiet — a fit for self-drivers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Panoramic room with a canal-view balcony — it's the prettiest corner of the hotel, and there are only a few, so request it when you book.
pros: Brand-new hotel — everything fresh and clean, rooms spacious
Leafy canalside pool with a gym
Friendly staff who can speak English
Free parking, plus a golf-simulator bar
cons: Khok Kham location outside town — still quiet, you need a car
Breakfast menu is still simple as the hotel is new

entries.name: Grand Inter Hotel
entries.addr: 19/99 Moo 2, SK.5031 Rd, Khok Kham, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Grand Inter Hotel is the 3-star hotel with the most reviews in this tier — over 450 — scoring 8.8, and the name business travellers near the Sinsakhon estate mention most. It opened in 2018 with spacious, modern rooms, many with balconies, plus a gym, a rooftop view deck and free parking. From around ฿700 it's strong value for rooms this size. The trade-off is the Khok Kham location right by the estate, with nowhere to stroll at night.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group or family? The 52 sqm Family Room splits much cheaper per head — and ask for a higher floor for a more open view.
pros: Most reviewed in this tier at 450+ — solid data
Spacious, modern rooms, many with balconies
Strong starting value for rooms this size
Free parking, with a gym and rooftop view deck
cons: By the industrial estate — nowhere to stroll nearby at night
Better for self-drivers than for those on public transport

entries.name: Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem
entries.revCount: 788 reviews · the most in this guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phetkasem Rd · Om Noi, Krathum Baen
entries.addr: 113/2 Moo 11, Phetkasem Rd, Om Noi, Krathum Baen
entries.storyHtml: Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem is the most-reviewed hotel in this guide — 788 reviews — scoring 8.2. It sits on Phetkasem Road in Om Noi, Krathum Baen, with easy access in and out of western Bangkok. The Superior-grade rooms are spacious with a tea/coffee kettle, and the Premier rooms add a small balcony, from around ฿900. What lifts it to this rank is the huge review base and steady scores — a fit for anyone who wants a hotel proven by a large number of guests.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If your budget stretches, step up to a Premier room with a balcony — airier and you can sit out for some air, for only a few hundred baht more.
pros: Most reviewed in this guide at 788 — very solid data
Spacious Superior-grade rooms with a tea/coffee kettle
On Phetkasem Rd, easy in and out of western Bangkok
Free parking, good for self-drivers

entries.name: The Residence Thepkanjana
entries.badge: 🚗 Best value on the Krathum Baen side
entries.addr: 403 Soi Khlong Maduea 12, Thepkanjana Rd, Khlong Maduea, Krathum Baen
entries.storyHtml: The Residence Thepkanjana is the best-value 3-star hotel on the Krathum Baen–Om Noi side, scoring 8.5 from 64 reviews. It opened in 2016 with 50 clean rooms, many with balconies, from just ฿600. It's in the Khlong Maduea area near Om Noi — a fit for anyone with factory business on the Krathum Baen side or heading in and out of western Bangkok. The area is fairly quiet with little to stroll to, so it suits self-drivers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Add a little for the Deluxe Twin with a balcony — much airier than the Standard for under two hundred baht more.
pros: Best starting value on the Krathum Baen side, from ฿600
Clean rooms, many with balconies, scoring 8.5
Near Om Noi, easy in and out of western Bangkok
Has parking, good for business self-drivers
cons: On the Krathum Baen side, far from central Mahachai and the sea
Quiet surroundings, nothing to stroll to at night

entries.name: The Eight
entries.addr: 1300/888 Norarat Uthit Rd, Mahachai, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: The Eight is the 3-star hotel in central Mahachai scoring 8.3, with spacious rooms and a central location as its strengths. It's a 7-storey building; the Eight Classic has a wide King bed, a fridge and a flat-screen TV from around ฿900. It's on Norarat Uthit Road in town, near markets and food shops — easier to walk out for an evening meal than the estate-side hotels. It has free parking, suiting both self-drivers and those who want to be right in town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a higher-floor Superior facing the street for a brighter, more open view — or an inner-facing room if you want it quieter.
pros: Central Mahachai — walk out for food in the evening
Spacious rooms in a 7-storey building, big beds
Free parking — rare for an in-town stay

entries.name: The Seaport Hotel
entries.revCount: 11 reviews · walk to the railway station
entries.addr: 923/14 Soi Ekachai 9/1, Ekachai Rd, Mahachai, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: The Seaport Hotel is the 3-star hotel in central Mahachai whose strength is its location — about a 790-metre walk to Mahachai railway station, scoring 8.3. It has a port-town look, with rooms around 26 sqm with a fridge, an LED TV and a water heater, plus parking, an on-site minimart and 24-hour staff. From around ฿750, it's a great fit for anyone arriving by train or coming to eat seafood in town without a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arriving by train at Mahachai? You can walk over and check in. Pick the 26 sqm Superior — much airier than the Mini room.
pros: About a 790 m walk to Mahachai station, good without a car

entries.name: Ruan Chai Nam Resort
entries.revCount: 28 reviews · on the Tha Chin River
entries.badge: 🌊 Resort on the Tha Chin River
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Bo · on the Tha Chin River
tags: 🌊 Rooms on the Tha Chin River
entries.addr: 14 Moo 4, Ban Bo, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Ruan Chai Nam Resort is a boutique resort on the Tha Chin River that offers a restful feel quite unlike the in-town hotels, scoring 8.2 from 28 reviews. Its draw is riverside rooms where you can sit out in the river breeze, plus an on-site cafe and restaurant, from around ฿1,000 (riverside rooms ฿1,400). It's in the Ban Bo area — a fit for anyone wanting a quiet riverside escape or a special-occasion stay rather than a rushed business trip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the full riverside feel, step up to a Riverside or VIP room — sitting out in the Tha Chin River breeze in the evening is the highlight here.

entries.name: Thongchen Residence
entries.addr: 1500/119 Soi Ekachai 11, Ekachai Rd, Mahachai, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Thongchen Residence is a new-room apartment in central Mahachai right next to Samut Sakhon Hospital, scoring 8.2 from 12 reviews. The studio-style rooms are new and spacious, some with a city-view balcony, and you can book by the day or the month, from around ฿750. Being next to the hospital makes it a great fit for anyone staying with a patient or on business in town, and it's on Soi Ekachai 11 near markets and food.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Staying several nights or with a patient? Ask about weekly or monthly rates — they often beat the daily price.

entries.name: Finland Resort Inn
entries.addr: 9/9 Moo 4, Bang Thorat, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Finland Resort Inn is the budget stay in the suburban Bang Thorat area with over a hundred reviews (102), scoring 7.5. Rooms are spacious with big beds and free water, from just ฿600, and there's a riverside restaurant on the grounds. It's in Bang Thorat outside town — a fit for anyone driving through or on business in the suburbs who wants a roomy stay on a budget. The trade-off is the out-of-town location and a local-stay level of service.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Add a little for the larger Deluxe Room — good for a couple or a multi-night stay, and still within budget.

entries.name: Central Place Hotel
entries.badge: 🏊 Has a pool · near the Tha Chin estate
entries.addr: 1242/469 Soi 4, Ekachai Rd, Tha Chin, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Central Place Hotel is the 3-star hotel on the Tha Chin side with a swimming pool, a fit for people working at the estate, scoring 7.3 from 22 reviews. Open since 2005 with 42 rooms, it has an outdoor pool, free parking, an EV charger and accepts pets, from around ฿1,100. The new-wing rooms are in better shape than the old wing. It's near the provincial stadium and about 2.5 km from the railway station — a fit for self-drivers with business in Tha Chin.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a new-wing (Deluxe) room when you book — clearly better condition than the old wing — and there's an EV charger if you drive electric.

entries.addr: 927/19 Rama II Frontage Rd, Mahachai, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: S9 Hotel Samutsakhon is a small 3-star hotel on the Rama II frontage road in central Mahachai, scoring 7.3 from 14 reviews. The Deluxe rooms have a 50-inch flat-screen TV and a rainshower, and the Superior rooms a small balcony, from around ฿700, with free parking. Its Rama II location makes it easy to drive in and out of Bangkok — a fit for self-drivers passing through or stopping over. It's a small hotel with limited rooms, so book ahead.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Deluxe room with the rainshower and the bigger TV — better value than the Standard for not much more.

entries.name: Sands Place Apartment and Hotel
entries.addr: 68 Moo 7, Soi Rung Setthakit 9, Setthakit 1 Rd, Tha Sai, Mueang Samut Sakhon
entries.storyHtml: Sands Place Apartment and Hotel is an apartment hotel in the Tha Sai area near CentralPlaza Mahachai, a fit for longer stays, scoring 6.9 from 24 reviews. The apartment-style rooms have sofas, and the Large Suite runs up to around 100 sqm, good for groups or multi-night stays, from around ฿800. Its draw is being near the Central mall, easy for shopping and food. The score isn't high yet — room condition and upkeep aren't always consistent — so check recent reviews before booking.

faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Samut Sakhon hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in in Samut Sakhon?
faq.a: It depends on your plans and whether you have a car. Central Mahachai is near the railway station, markets and seafood, best without a car (The Seaport, The Eight, S9, Thongchen). Khok Kham is near Talad Talay Thai and the Sinsakhon estate, quiet, good for self-drivers (Phetara, Grand Inter). Tha Chin sits by the river and the estates (Central Place, Ruan Chai Nam). Krathum Baen–Om Noi is on the Phetkasem side, close to western Bangkok (Jolly Suites, The Residence Thepkanjana).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Samut Sakhon hotels cost?
faq.a: Samut Sakhon is affordable: budget stays start around ฿600–750 (The Residence Thepkanjana, Finland, The Seaport, Thongchen, S9, Grand Inter); midrange 3-star hotels are around ฿800–1,100 (The Eight, Jolly Suites, Sands Place, Central Place, Ruan Chai Nam); and the new 4-star Phetara starts around ฿1,100, rising to about ฿1,800 for a canal-view room.

faq.q: ❓ Arriving by train — where can I stay within walking distance?
faq.a: Samut Sakhon has Mahachai railway station (the Mae Klong line) in the town centre. Stays within walking distance or close to the station are The Seaport Hotel (about a 790-metre walk) and The Eight (central Mahachai, near markets) — ideal if you arrive by train and want to walk straight to the markets and food.

faq.q: ❓ Which Samut Sakhon hotels have a swimming pool?
faq.a: In this guide, the ones with a pool are Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL (a new 4-star hotel with a canalside pool) and Central Place Hotel (an outdoor pool on the Tha Chin side). Both start around ฿1,100.

faq.q: ❓ Here on business near an industrial estate — where should I stay?
faq.a: Pick by which estate you're near. Grand Inter Hotel ฿700 and Phetara ฿1,100 are in Khok Kham near the Sinsakhon estate; Central Place ฿1,100 is in Tha Chin near the estate; and Jolly Suites & Spa Petkasem ฿900 is on the Krathum Baen–Om Noi side, good for factory work on the Phetkasem side.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Samut Sakhon hotel?
faq.a: On ordinary weekdays, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is plenty, as Samut Sakhon isn't a packed tourist market. But on long weekends and holidays, good rooms — especially the new Phetara and riverside stays like Ruan Chai Nam — fill fast, so book 2–4 weeks ahead or more.
